correctness.rationale: The exact logarithmic-coordinate profile equation isolates a forcing proportional to c_*^(m-1) m r(m r-N+2) exp(-q t). The source far-field stable-node reduction supplies the competing exponents q=L/(p-1) and h=L/(m-p); variation of constants yields the forced, resonant, and free-mode cases. Symbolic checks reproduce all coefficient and exponent identities.

originality.rationale: The source proves the common leading tail and displays the far-field stable eigenvalues but does not state the m=2p-1 comparison, second-order coefficients, logarithmic far-field resonance, or harmonic cancellation. Searches found no source-specific equivalent. General critical-exponent logarithms and homogeneous-absorption theory are prior art and are excluded from novelty; older homogeneous-absorption full texts remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result sharpens a universal leading tail into a parameter-dependent second-order classification, gives an eventual side of approach in a full regime, identifies where profile memory first survives, and isolates two distinct codimension-one mechanisms relevant to comparison and matched-asymptotic analysis.
